name: White Bean Purée with Asparagus & Fried Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a small saucepan over medium heat.
Trim off and discard the root ends of the garlic; peel and mince or press the garlic.
Once the saucepan is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add the garlic to the saucepan; cook until fragrant, 15 to 30 seconds.
Add the beans and ½ of the broth to the saucepan; bring to a boil, then mash the beans with a hand blender or potato masher.
instructions.secondary_message: 177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add the remaining broth, most of the Parmesan (save a little for garnishing), salt, and pepper to the bean purée; stir to combine. Remove the saucepan from the heat and cover to keep warm.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add butter to a nonstick skillet and preheat over medium heat.

Gently crack 6 of the eggs into the skillet. Cook until the tops of the whites are set but the yolks are still runny, 3 to 4 minutes. Once done, separate the eggs and transfer to a plate. Repeat with the remaining 6 eggs.
While the eggs cook, snap or cut off and discard the woody ends of the asparagus; cut the spears into 2 ½-cm pieces at an angle.
Once the eggs have been transferred, add more butter to the skillet.

Add the asparagus to the skillet and season with salt and pepper; cook, tossing frequently, until the asparagus is bright green and just tender, 4 to 6 minutes. Once done, remove the skillet from the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, spoon the bean purée into a bowl, top with the asparagus and fried eggs, sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan, and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Enjoy!
